_readme: OPTIONAL hai - ye lagaye bina bhi portal poora sahi chalta hai.
Default me ward ka data mapping se aata hai: WardWise/{ward} batati hai ki
kaun se uid chahiye, phir sirf wahi record padhe jaate hain. Isme koi index
nahi chahiye.
Ye index ek TEZ vikalp chaalu karta hai - ward ka poora data ek hi query me
(MarkersData.orderByChild('ward').equalTo(ward)).
Lagane ka tareeka:
1. Ye poore rules NAHI hain. Niche wala 'rules' hissa apne project ke
maujooda database rules me MERGE karein, replace na karein.
Firebase Console > Realtime Database > Rules, phir Publish.
2. Portal me ward page kholkar browser console dekhein - 'FIREBASE
WARNING: Using an unspecified index' nahi aani chahiye.
3. Tabhi marker-mapping.service.ts me wardQueryEnabled = true karein.
Har city ka apna project hai (dtdtonk, dtdratangarh, dtdnokha, dtdlosal...),
isliye ye har project me alag se lagana padta hai. Ek me laga hone ka matlab
baaki me laga hona nahi hai.
Step 3 se pehle 2 chhodna khatarnaak hai: index bina query se RTDB mana nahi
karta, wo poora MarkersData node browser ko bhej deta hai. Yaani ek ward
kholne par poore shehar ke marker download. Data galat nahi hota, error bhi
nahi aata - bas read bahut mehnga ho jaata hai aur kahin dikhta nahi.
